summary: ADI Global Distribution Inc., a wholesale hardware distributor, filed a Form 8-K on July 31, 2026, reporting its separation and spin-off from parent Resideo Technologies, Inc. The Separation and Distribution Agreement transfers the ADI business to ADI and distributes all ADI common stock to Resideo shareholders of record as of July 20, 2026. Ancillary agreements cover employees, taxes, transition services, and IP. On August 3, 2026, ADI entered into a Registration Rights Agreement with CD&R Channel Holdings. The information statement details related-party transactions. The spin-off creates a standalone publicly traded entity on the NYSE under ADIG, with no cash consideration or premium applicable. Watch for post-distribution trading dynamics and any related-party service arrangements affecting financials.
